business_summary: Xinjiang Joinworld Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of aluminum products in China and internationally. The company offers aluminum, electronic aluminum foil, medium and high voltage electrode foil, corrosion foil, etched foil, chemical foil, formed foil, aluminum alloys, and other electronic components. Its aluminum products are used in electronics, integrated circuits, and other fields, such as electronic aluminum foil, electronic guide wire, and alumina powder; and electronic consumer goods, energy-saving wires, automobile engines, automobile and architectural decoration, and other fields, including electronics, electricity, transportation, and construction, as well as for the production of electrode foils and aluminum electrolytic capacitors. In addition, the company provides general road cargo and air transportation, freight forwarding, warehousing, and loading and unloading; property management and house leasing; container logistics and leasing, and supply chain services; industrial furnaces and supporting equipment; mechanical and electrical equipment and components; metal doors and windows; electronic materials; technical research and development; engineering design; and consulting services for aluminum, related alloy materials, and aluminum processing products, as well as for non-ferrous metals and electronic materials. Further, it is involved in the import and export of goods and technologies; mining development, research, production, and sales of magnesium products; non-ferrous metal rolling processing; and investment activities. Xinjiang Joinworld Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Urumqi, China.
